goal: Fix a real compositing defect (Destination In / Destination Atop clearing incorrectly outside the source layer's own declared raster bounds) found via an independent mathematical oracle during ORA-COMPOSITE-001's own full-inventory producer-verification sweep, per this session's own explicit A4 instruction to fix repository-owned defects with focused regression tests.
obligation_selection_basis: Deliberately selected: discovered mid-flow while building real two-producer (GIMP + Krita) evidence for this exact obligation's own unmet 'all claimed operations match pinned rendering references' release gate, not an arbitrary/unrelated change.

characterization.affected_behavior: _composite_layer_onto's own bounds-clipping loop, used by every composite-op, both Source Over blend functions and the 5 non-default Porter-Duff operators.
characterization.caller_blast_radius: All public rendering entry points share this one private compositing primitive; no public API signature changed.

failing_test_first.failure_mode: AssertionError: destination pixels outside the source layer's own raster bounds were left unchanged (e.g. (230,60,40,153)) instead of cleared to (0,0,0,0), for Destination In and Destination Atop specifically.

contrast_test.purpose: Proves the fix does not over-correct the 3 operators (Source Over, Lighter, Destination Out, Source Atop) whose own Porter-Duff Fb coefficient genuinely equals 1.0 at alpha_s=0 -- already passed before the fix and still passes after.

root_cause: _composite_layer_onto only ever iterated the intersection of canvas bounds and the source layer's own raster bounds, implicitly treating every pixel outside that intersection as alpha_s=0 with NO compositing applied at all. Correct for Source Over (Fb=1-alpha_s=1 at alpha_s=0, i.e. genuinely unchanged) and, coincidentally, for Lighter/Destination Out/Source Atop (each also has Fb=1.0 at alpha_s=0). Incorrect for Destination In and Destination Atop, whose own Fb=alpha_s=0.0 at alpha_s=0 -- the destination must be cleared there per Porter & Duff (1984), not left untouched.
fix: Evaluate the 5 non-Source-Over Porter-Duff operators over the FULL canvas (not just the source layer's own bounds), with out-of-bounds pixels given the explicit alpha_s=0, cs=(0,0,0) the formula itself expects. Source Over keeps its own existing bounds-clipped fast path unchanged, since it is correct there, not merely coincidental.

regression_tests.full_ora_suite_result: 462 passed, 0 failed (459 before this fix's own 3 new tests)

typing_and_lint.mypy: clean (no new errors introduced by this change)

proof_inputs.independent_oracle: tools/ora/producer_harness/composite_oracle.py::porter_duff_coeffs (independently re-derived from Porter & Duff 1984, not the module under fix)
